ADHD hacks i wish
someone told me at 16

write it down the second
you think of it.

if it stays in your head,
it's already gone

put what you need tomorrow
right in front of the door.

literally in the way.
you can't forget
what you trip over

give your alarms names.

not "alarm 3".
"leave NOW or you miss the bus".
your brain respects a deadline

pick one "starting song".

the same song every time
you sit down to work.
after a while your brain
starts moving on the first note

stop waiting to feel ready.

with ADHD the motivation
usually shows up
after you start, not before

i post the ADHD hacks
that work for me.

follow for more
